fullPassage: Capuchins ― New World Monkeys that live in large social groups ― will, in captivity, trade with people all day long, especially if food is involved. I give you this rock and you give me a treat to eat. If you put two monkeys in cages next to each other, and offer them both slices of cucumber for the rocks they already have, they will happily eat the cucumbers. If, however, you give one monkey grapes instead ― grapes being universally preferred to cucumbers ― the monkey that is still receiving cucumbers will begin to throw them back at the experimenter. Even though she is still getting "paid" the same amount for her effort of sourcing rocks, and so her particular situation has not changed, the comparison to another makes the situation unfair. Furthermore, she is now willing to abandon all gains ― the cucumbers themselves ― to communicate her displeasure to the experimenter.

❌ ④ trade — preferred — fair: (C) fair(공평한)는 unfair(불공평한)의 반대

❌ ② (A) 간식 — (B) 치료하다: (A)는 동사 '치료하다'가 적절
❌ ③ (A) 치료하다/다루다 — (B) 대접: (B)는 먹는 '간식'이 적절
❌ ④ (A) 속이다 — (B) 간식: (A)의 treat은 속이다가 아닌 치료하다
det.tip: treat: ① (동사) 치료하다/다루다 ② (명사) 간식/맛있는 것

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a person who performs a scientific test to study something"

det.korean: experimenter=실험자 (무언가를 연구하기 위해 과학적 실험을 수행하는 사람)
det.analysis:
❌ ① cucumber: cucumber(오이)는 사람이 아닌 채소
✅ ② experimenter: experimenter(실험자)는 과학적 실험을 수행하는 사람으로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ captivity: captivity(감금 상태)는 사람이 아닌 상태
❌ ④ comparison: comparison(비교)은 사람이 아닌 행위
det.tip: experimenter = 실험자. throw them back at the experimenter가 본문 단서

questions.passage: The monkey that is still __________ (receive) cucumbers will begin to throw them back at the experimenter. Even though she is still getting "paid" the same amount for her effort of sourcing rocks, and so her particular situation has not changed, the comparison to another makes the situation unfair.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 'that is still __________ cucumbers'에서 be동사 is 뒤에 현재진행형을 완성하는 현재분사가 필요. '여전히 오이를 받고 있는'이라는 진행의 의미. receive → receiving
det.tip: be동사 + V-ing = 현재진행형 (is receiving = 받고 있다)

questions.passage: Even though she is still getting __________ (pay) the same amount for her effort of sourcing rocks, her particular situation has not changed. Furthermore, she is now willing to abandon all gains ― the cucumbers themselves ― to communicate her displeasure to the experimenter.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 'getting __________ the same amount'에서 get + 과거분사는 '~되다/당하다'라는 수동의 의미(get + p.p.). '보수를 받다(get paid)'라는 뜻이므로 과거분사 paid가 적절. pay → paid
det.tip: get + 과거분사 = 수동(~되다). get paid = 보수를 받다

questions.passage: Capuchins ― New World Monkeys that live in large social groups ― will, in captivity, trade with people all day long, especially if food is involved. I give you this rock and you give me a treat to eat. If you put two monkeys in cages next to each other, and offer them both slices of cucumber for the rocks they already have, they will happily eat the cucumbers. If, however, you give one monkey grapes instead ― grapes being universally preferred to cucumbers ― the monkey that is still receiving cucumbers will begin to __________ at the experimenter. Even though she is still getting "paid" the same amount for her effort of sourcing rocks, and so her particular situation has not changed, the comparison to another makes the situation unfair. Furthermore, she is now willing to abandon all gains ― the cucumbers themselves ― to communicate her displeasure to the experimenter.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: throw them back=그것들을 되던지다 — 여전히 오이를 받는 원숭이가 실험자에게 하는 행동
det.analysis:
❌ ① share them equally(똑같이 나누다): 불공평에 항의하는 맥락과 반대
❌ ② eat them quietly(조용히 먹다): 항의 행동과 반대
❌ ③ hide them away(숨기다): 던지는 항의 행동과 다름
✅ ④ throw them back(되던지다): 원문 일치. 오이를 받는 원숭이가 그것을 실험자에게 '되던지기' 시작한다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: will begin to throw them back at the experimenter — 실험자에게 되던지다

questions.passage: Capuchins ― New World Monkeys that live in large social groups ― will, in captivity, trade with people all day long, especially if food is involved. Even though she is still getting "paid" the same amount for her effort of sourcing rocks, and so her particular situation has not changed, the comparison to another __________. Furthermore, she is now willing to abandon all gains ― the cucumbers themselves ― to communicate her displeasure to the experimenter.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: makes the situation unfair=상황을 불공평하게 만든다 — 다른 원숭이와의 비교가 하는 역할
det.analysis:
❌ ① solves the whole problem(문제를 해결한다): 항의를 유발하는 맥락과 반대
❌ ② makes everyone much happier(모두를 행복하게 한다): 불쾌감을 유발하는 맥락과 반대
✅ ③ makes the situation unfair(상황을 불공평하게 만든다): 원문 일치. 자신의 상황은 변하지 않았어도 다른 원숭이와의 비교가 상황을 '불공평하게 만든다'는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ has no real effect at all(아무 영향이 없다): 비교가 항의를 유발하므로 반대
det.tip: the comparison to another makes the situation unfair

ch: has no real effect at all
